scientific.integrity: The theorem is derived from the exact distributed EF21 recursion after scalar normalization. Exchangeability closes the second moments in four variables, and the unique positive unit-eigenvalue crossing of the positive covariance operator gives the sharp boundary.
limitations: The exact formula uses identical scalar client Hessians and independent half-dropout compressors.
The result is a mean-square stability statement and does not classify almost-sure Lyapunov exponents.
Heterogeneous curvatures, correlated compression, stochastic gradients, and momentum variants are outside scope.
The large-worker value six is specific to this scalar lagged-memory model.

title: Exact worker-count mean-square stability frontier for scalar EF21
